ops.text:
Timeline through 2026-07-26 ~08:20Z (final machine outcomes appended when they land).

**The incident**: Jul 17, a codex session debugging one bug in claude-pool ("acct-18 content catch-up: context deadline exceeded", yasyf-home) became a recursive multi-agent swarm — 150 top-level agents, depth-6 nesting, 1,948 rollout files / 11 GB, ~1.8B tokens over 7 days. It cut ~15 daemonkit releases in 2 days, shipped three incompatible cc-pool store-schema epochs in 4 days (c2147e4 Jul 20 → v0.62 line Jul 23 → v0.64 line Jul 24, zero migrations, zero records), hard-cut the synckit state envelope + manifest model (d8dde6a; migration tooling deleted in 434c652 on the false premise every host had converged), destroyed 17 of 20 cc-pool account config dirs on yasyf-home, and left both remote machines' sync meshes fully wedged: cc-pool daemons died at their epoch-crossing upgrade moments (home Jul 22 04:42; box similar), box synckit serve ran a deleted 0.21.0 image from the Jul 19 boot (KeepAlive never restarts a non-exiting process) producing 20,471 handshake failures, and every reposync CLI command on home was wedged by the envelope. Swarm killed by the user Jul 24.

**The stabilization pass (this session, Jul 25 evening → Jul 26)**:
- Settlement fix (P1 4497f65) landed as 85d53fd: deferred durable untrack off the child settlement path; adversarially reviewed (sol finder/refuter + falsification runs); CI green after a pre-existing-flake rerun (flake filed as 29a01afd).
- **v0.20.6 declared the frozen fleet baseline** (signed tag; release freeze until convergence). The GitHub release object never published — tag signed with the wrong key and the immutable-v*-tags ruleset correctly refuses re-signing; accepted as cosmetic (note f3a31f7f).
- Repin wave: all downstreams to v0.20.6 with green CI — 11 planned + cookiesync discovered as a missed 12th.
- Release wave: fusekit v1.15.3 (Swift pin — unblocked cc-pool's SPM diamond), cc-pool v0.64.8 (+ 3 settlement-race test fixes bbcc94f + widget FuseKit bump), synckit v0.36.2, cc-patch v0.12.2, reposync v0.27.4, cc-notes v0.47.10, captain-hook v12.20.10, cc-present v0.31.2, cc-review v0.33.2, cc-orchestrate v0.15.2; cookiesync v0.27.3 in flight. All trusted-key signed, Release workflows green, tap bumps verified. cc-interact needs no release (pure library).
- Local (A6): 10 packages converged; cc-patch fully repaired (its own remedy had destroyed pack registrations — fast mode was silently OFF; restored, 2.1.220 patched); capt-hookd healthy but deployed bundle held at 12.20.9 by a wedged helper label (convergence surgery pending quiet fan-outs).
- yasyf box: 18 leaked kill/reap-test processes killed under an evidence gate across 5 test families; zombie 0.21.0 serve cleared (handshake counter frozen); brew converged (partial verification — box has dropped off the network twice on a dying WiFi stack; physical intervention recommended to the user).
- yasyf-home: full cutover to daemonkit-owned services — synckit state moved aside + fresh v1 envelope + `synckitd install`; serve healthy on the staged 0.36.2 binary, zero-consumer, error counter frozen at 1224. reposync lossless envelope migration verified (amended for a tombstoned local_only edge); cc-pool store recreate is user-gated (20 accounts need interactive re-auth; roster dumped).
- Records filed across the fleet: daemonkit 955ce63c (bootstrap-EIO recovery gap), 2c931c18 (test-helper leaks), 29a01afd, 34996a3b (spawn-gate P1, pre-existing); cc-pool 0896d69 (schema epochs, P1) + investigation 4a6bdeb (wild orphaned worker); reposync c4127dc (repo add --local-only wedges CLI, P1); synckit 73170ef (ErrStateSchema no-repair-no-tooling, P1); cc-patch a9f909a (remedy loses registrations, P1); cc-notes c6d416e (record.py dict TypeError, P1); captain-hook dc97d32 (helper install false success, P1). Orchestration lessons: doc f2ec2cb4.
